description: Due date of a Form 990-N, 990-EZ, 990 or 990-PF for a fiscal year end and tax year, moved off weekends and legal holidays, the Form 8868 extended due date (none for the 990-N), days remaining, and late-filing consequences. Give the fiscal year end month or an EIN. Tax year = the calendar year the accounting year begins in; default is the latest ended year.

ein.description: Employer Identification Number, 9 digits, with or without the dash (12-3456789)

fiscal_year_end_month.description: Month the accounting year ends, 1-12 (12 = December 31)

name: get_filing_due_date
title: Form 990 due date
